title: SURE-AGENT-EVAL main-flow run report
description: Structured output of the RUN_REPORT unit. Same closing contract as the other SURE skills: the agent previews the report, the user confirms, then it is persisted.

status.description: Final run state: success | failed | incomplete.

run_dir.description: Agent product directory holding predictions/, protocol.yaml, prediction_generation_status.json and evaluation_runs/.

report_persisted.description: RUN_REPORT_UNIT gate: the report must be previewed and user-confirmed before persistence.

evaluation_only.description: True when the evaluate unit ran but run_agent did not (re-scored an existing bundle).
